component.name: mustache
component.title: Mustache
component.description: Render a Mustache template with the data of the message and use the text it writes as the new message body.
component.label: transformation

allowContextMapAll.description: Sets whether the context map should allow access to all details. By default only the message body and headers can be accessed. This option can be enabled for full access to the current Exchange and CamelContext. Doing so impose a potential security risk as this opens access to the full power of CamelContext API.

allowTemplateFromHeader.description: Whether to allow to use resource template from header or not (default false). Enabling this allows to specify dynamic templates via message header. However this can be seen as a potential security vulnerability if the header is coming from a malicious user, so use this with care.

contentCache.description: Sets whether to use resource content cache or not

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

mustacheFactory.label: advanced
mustacheFactory.description: To use a custom com.github.mustachejava.MustacheFactory, which compiles the templates of all endpoints of the component and reads the partials that they include. If not set, the component uses a com.github.mustachejava.DefaultMustacheFactory. The startDelimiter and endDelimiter options are only applied with a DefaultMustacheFactory.

CamelMustacheResourceUri.description: The URI of a template resource that the producer renders in place of the resource of resourceUri, in the same form as resourceUri. Only used when allowTemplateFromHeader is true. The producer removes the header and renders the template with the mustache endpoint for that URI, which takes the options of the component, not those of this endpoint.

CamelMustacheTemplate.description: The text of a template that the producer renders in place of the resource of resourceUri. Only used when allowTemplateFromHeader is true. The producer removes the header and compiles the text for each exchange, with the startDelimiter and endDelimiter of the endpoint.

producerIn.description: The template gets the body as body, as it is: text, or a Map, a List or a POJO to read from; convert bytes or a stream to a String first. The template is the resource, or the CamelMustacheTemplate or CamelMustacheResourceUri header with allowTemplateFromHeader=true, and never the body

producerOut.description: The text the template writes, also when it is JSON: unmarshal it to read its fields. Values in double braces are HTML-escaped, in triple braces as they are. The headers are kept

resourceUri.description: Path to the resource. You can prefix with: classpath, file, http, ref, or bean. classpath, file and http loads the resource using these protocols (classpath is default). ref will lookup the resource in the registry. bean will call a method on a bean to be used as the resource. For bean you can specify the method name after dot, eg bean:myBean.myMethod.

allowContextMapAll.description: Sets whether the context map should allow access to all details. By default only the message body and headers can be accessed. This option can be enabled for full access to the current Exchange and CamelContext. Doing so impose a potential security risk as this opens access to the full power of CamelContext API.

allowTemplateFromHeader.description: Whether to allow to use resource template from header or not (default false). Enabling this allows to specify dynamic templates via message header. However this can be seen as a potential security vulnerability if the header is coming from a malicious user, so use this with care.

contentCache.description: Sets whether to use resource content cache or not

encoding.description: The name of the character encoding (charset) that the producer uses to read the template resource of resourceUri, for example UTF-8. If not set, the default charset of the JVM is used. Not used for the template of the CamelMustacheTemplate header, which is already text, nor for partials, which the mustacheFactory reads.

endDelimiter.description: The characters that end a tag in the template, in place of }}. It can be set without startDelimiter, which then stays {{. Only applied when the mustacheFactory of the component is a com.github.mustachejava.DefaultMustacheFactory, which it is by default; with another factory the endpoint logs a WARN. Also applied to the template of the CamelMustacheTemplate header.

startDelimiter.description: The characters that start a tag in the template, in place of {{. It can be set without endDelimiter, which then stays }}. Only applied when the mustacheFactory of the component is a com.github.mustachejava.DefaultMustacheFactory, which it is by default; with another factory the endpoint logs a WARN. Also applied to the template of the CamelMustacheTemplate header.
